title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Good morning, Doctor. Can I paint a portrait of you? And don't worry, I'll try not to... bring it to life. Besides, it's not like I can bring everything to life, you know.

title: Talk 1
original: Maybe I wasn't supposed to appear here?…

title: Talk 2
original: Doctor... what color are you, reflected in my eyes?

title: Talk 3
original: There are lots of fun, creative things here at Rhodes Island. I'm feeling inspired…

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: See my lovely 'assistants'? Hehe… What? You think they're scary? But, but they're so cute!

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Heh, so these are the colors of your soul…? Alright then, look at me. And paint me in those colors, your colors.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: That's right. Even if no one understands me, I'll keep making art. No matter what kinds of monsters my works might become…

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: We artists are a unique breed… We spend at least thirty days a month stuck in a rut, thinking all our work is trash. And we only make any progress when inspiration strikes after midnight.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: In the end, the mottled world sleeps peacefully in the dark depths—Yes, that's the true color of the ocean. Black is the only color you see? Looks like I still have more to share with you…

title: Idle
original: Are you... dreaming? Is the world in your dreams as colorful as the beings of this world, Doctor…?

title: Onboard
original: I'm Deepcolor, a painter. Yes, just a 'painter', nothing more.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: What's this unsettling feeling...?

title: Promotion 1
original: Um, could you just... stop caring about me? If you keep treating me so well... I-I don't know what I might become…

title: Promotion 2
original: Thank you, Doctor. Now, let's complete this work of art, shall we?

title: Added to Squad
original: You're sending me to fight? Seriously?!

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I can't lead so many people.

title: Depart
original: Do your best, everyone!

title: Begin Operation
original: Is that who we're fighting?!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Me?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: What do I do?

title: Deployment 1
original: Scumble-scumble...

title: Deployment 2
original: Aww, I just need a minute!

title: In Battle 1
original: No need to rush.

title: In Battle 2
original: Let's take it slow.

title: In Battle 3
original: You'll have to get past my 'assistants' first.

title: In Battle 4
original: Can you defeat my little ones?

title: 4-star Result
original: If you really make me mad... you won't like what happens next.

title: 3-star Result
original: Let me sketch these triumphant heroes.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Aw, got my clothes dirty again...

title: Operation Failure
original: If only battles were like sketches. I'd just erase that one and redo it…

title: Assigned to Facility
original: This room's got a nice design.

title: Tap
original: Hm?

title: Trust Tap
original: Doctor, since we happen to have some time off, want to see my latest work?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year, Doctor. What colors do I see for the coming year? Hm… the aroma of food, smiling operators, and presents full of kindness… a warm, tender turmeric? It's like nothing I've ever felt. I have to get this onto a canvas.

title: Greeting
original: Good morning, Doctor.

title: Birthday
original: Here's a hand-drawn birthday card. Do you like it? Heheh. I have two birthdays myself, in a way. I achieved a new form, after accepting the gift. Here, Doctor, look—I created this color, but it is entirely yours.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: What day is it? Oh, of course. I see my 'assistants' are all joining in on the fun. Alright, why don't we let them make an even more beautiful piece for Rhodes Island?
